Validations.Reason: The chapter explicitly establishes Adrian's enrollment in Protocol 7-B, his financial desperation (rent due in 3 days, $60 bill, low cash), the specific daily requirements (medication at 0800, collection at 1000), the compensation structure ($14 base + $30 bonus = $44 total), and the dehumanizing nature of the work. This constitutes a new, durable narrative thread regarding his survival and the trial's demands.

The chapter describes specific physiological and psychological reactions to the medication (intense heat, tremors, heightened sensory awareness, 'sharper, more brittle' thoughts) and ends with the ambiguous line 'something else was humming too... Something waiting.' This establishes a mystery regarding the true nature and long-term effects of the drug, which is not resolved in the chapter.
